race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
race.verdict: It might be worth chancing AMAZONIAN DREAM , a former C&D winner who hasn't been seen to best effect in recent starts and has dipped to only 1 lb above the mark he defied at Windsor in July. Courageous Sioux , an unexposed 3-y-o, Methgal and Slot are feared most in that order. AMAZONIAN DREAM (IRE) COURAGEOUS SIOUX METHGAL (IRE)
